 Back To Top Home › Guides › Rob Run Gun Durability
 By Zack , Jen Rothery , +3 more Updated : Nov 17, 2026 3:35pm UTC Add IGN on Google Your guns and weaponry gradually break down as you use them in Rob Run . It's a way to ensure you're consistently spending money and have something to use as you continue to finance your criminal activities. As it stands, Rob Run is in early access, and gun repairs are not available in the current build. However, the development team has promised that they're on the way. Here's what we know about gun durability in Rob Run.
 When Can You Repair Guns in Rob Run? 
 In a Steam news post released on Nov. 13, the team addressed some of the community's most frequently asked questions and mentioned that gear durability degrading is a deliberate choice to help balance the in-game economy.
 However, weapon and gear repair will be available in a future update . 
 Weapon Durability Explained 
 A weapon's durability decreases every time you die. If you go down multiple times, expect the weapon to not function as well as it does when it's above the threshold. Whenever you defeat another player, you can inspect the durability by highlighting it while it's in your inventory. It will be under the weapon's magazine size and weapon range graph.
 For now, though, any weapon that loses durability cannot be repaired in Rob Run. If there's a weapon you want to continue using, store it somewhere in your home, and wait for the weapon repair kits to become available. We'll also be updating this section when we learn more about how this gameplay mechanic works for everyone.
